decision.question: How should restaurant delivery orders be fulfilled?

objective.primary: Create a cozy restaurant-management experience with meaningful progression and low busywork.

goals.text: Avoid excessive micromanagement and repetitive chores.
NPCs and hired staff should have meaningful gameplay roles.

constraints.text: The feature scope must remain realistic for a small development team.

settled_decisions.text: The player can hire restaurant staff.

options.text: The player personally delivers every order.
Delivery resolves automatically after accepting the order.

unknowns: Exact pathfinding and scheduling implementation cost is not yet measured.
